verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs describe built-in observability that tracks project performance with every deployment and shows visitor behavior, which covers both parts of the story. The evidence is a single summary-level docs line with no detail on metrics or depth. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the specific performance and visitor analytics metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can track site performance and visitor behavior with built-in analytics

citations.quote: Track your project's performance with every deployment and understand your Netlify team's behavior and the behavior of visitors to your site or app.
